name: Mod Roundels
description: Bold three-ring roundels overlapping like scales, each row tucked under the one above, the rings changing color on every redraw.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2)); transform: scale(1.42); z-index: @calc(100 - @y); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 21%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 38%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color5)); transform: scale(@r(.7, 1.25)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
